The mixer transport adapts the play button, progress slider and time display from the [ElevenLabs Audio Player on 21st.dev](https://21st.dev/@ElevenLabs/components/audio-player). The [publisher's component registry](https://ui.elevenlabs.io/r/audio-player.json) supplies the React source. The mixer connects it to each deck's Track Control audio graph and uses the site's styles. The [upstream license](https://github.com/elevenlabs/ui/blob/3a28ebab197f8cfa599934f52db12ad1396e54f4/LICENSE.md) is distributed with the site.
